title: Private Surf Lesson in Venice Beach, CA
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
At Sunrise Surf Academy, every lesson is built around you. Our personalized, flexible approach ensures surfers of all ages and skill levels get the experience they’re looking for—whether it's your first wave or fine-tuning technique.

Our instructors bring elite surf experience and a genuine passion for teaching. They’re more than great surfers—they’re encouraging mentors committed to helping you grow in a supportive, fun environment.

Safety is central to our mission. All instructors are trained in ocean safety, CPR, and first aid, and are experts at reading conditions and creating a secure learning space. From the beach briefing to in-water coaching, we focus on making you feel confident and prepared.

Whether you're a first-timer or chasing clean lines, we’re here to make your session unforgettable. With top-tier instruction, local knowledge, and a deep respect for the ocean, Sunrise Surf Academy offers more than a lesson—we offer the stoke of surfing in its purest form.
